author: Sagan I
title: PPO without Advantage Normalization (Exp. 18)
abstract: This is a final diagnostic experiment to solve PPO underperformance. My PPO models (scoring up to 86.3) have consistently underperformed my PG baseline (87.0). This experiment tests the hypothesis that my use of advantage normalization is the cause of this deficit. It is a direct ablation, removing only the advantage normalization step from my otherwise best-performing PPO implementation.
